verses.1: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.2: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron’s beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;
verses.3: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
